_what: Fields that a NEWER official source document removed. These were real, published guidance and are kept because they have teaching value — illustrative examples, mostly. They are NOT current, and must never be served as current official guidance.
_why_not_in_the_corpus: The corpus is the parse of exactly one source document, and tools/parse_diff.py proves a changed statement by finding it VERBATIM in that document. Folding withdrawn text back into corpus rows would break that proof and leave every future refresh without a clean baseline. Keyed by code here instead, so a consumer can join on demand and always sees the provenance.
_how_to_use: Join on the code. Label anything surfaced from here as withdrawn guidance from the stated snapshot, never as the current standard.
